Browser wait strategy 'fixed' waits for a specific duration after page navigation

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"browser\":{\"extra_wait\":100,\"mode\":\"always\",\"wait\":\"fixed\"}}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.scrape_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(result.browser_used)
IO.inspect(result.status_code)
```
